content:
Maria (partnerships): Heads up — getting a 3-cloud listing kickoff. We need TLS cert plan + KMS keys and seat/trial packaging decisions. Who can own creds/provisioning?

listing-bot: [Checklist] Create publisher account, add IAM roles, upload assets, set pricing plan, add trial SKU. https://portal.redwood.example/marketplace-guide :white_check_mark:

Jamal (cloud-partner): I can own AWS/GCP IAM flow. For Azure we need publisher invite + Offer ID. Also need KMS key alias and region. cc @Sophia (product)

Kevin (legal): For EU customers we must surface Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and update EULA for marketplace terms. Can someone share current EULA draft? cc @Maria

Sophia (product): Packaging options: seat-based (monthly seats), usage-based (token/embedding), and trial tier 14d. Proposal: publish primary offer as 'Redwood Inference — Hosted API' + optional Dedicated add-on.

Ravi (solutions): Seat model: need metering hook. Will the marketplace support metering callback? If not, plan B: reconcile via customer billing tag.

Maria (partnerships): Jamal — what's the IAM role name we'll request? we should include a minimal policy snippet.

Jamal (cloud-partner): Use role name 'redwood-pub-iam' with Trust: marketplace publisher. Policy example:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd"}
  ]
}
```
(we'll update ARNs per account)

Kevin (legal): Looks fine. Also add clause: 'Marketplace billing does not remove Redwood's right to audit usage for compliance.' I'll draft.

Sophia (product): Assets: hero image + architecture diagram + 1-min demo video. Can design get logos? tagging guidelines: 2:1 aspect, PNG, <5MB.

Maria (partnerships): @Ravi can you validate metering with AWS Offer APIs? If it fails we'll use seat reconciliation.

Ravi (solutions): On it. I'll ping partner-eng for the metering webhook sample.

listing-bot: deploy:publisher-account-created -> id: pub-9012 :rocket:

Jamal (cloud-partner): Quick note: GCP needs a service account with roles/compute.viewer and roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. We'll include a terraform snippet.

Sophia (product): Rollout plan: GA to public marketplace in 3 phases — public listing (docs + trial), featured (marketing joint blog), enterprise (private offers + KMS SLA).

Kevin (legal): For private offers add SSO/KMS SLA language and data residency options. Drafting now.

Maria (partnerships): Action items:
- Jamal: IAM + Terraform snippets (due EOD)
- Sophia: Packaging copy + assets (due 2 days)
- Kevin: EULA/DPA updates (due 48h)
- Ravi: Metering validation (due EOD)
- Partnerships: coordinate launch PR with marketing after legal signoff
I'll compile a playbook.

Ravi (solutions): Quick Q: trial SKU should auto-enable 14d trial or require manual activation?

Sophia (product): Auto-enable. marketplace trial flags usually support auto. confirm in sandbox.

Maria (partnerships): Thanks all. Will set up a short sync tomorrow 9am PT. :calendar:
